method: API 36 x86_64 SwiftShader emulator; R8, Full AOT; 10 iterations x 3 open/Back round trips per APK; 420 dpi, font 1.0, three-button navigation. Sequential same-session runs, no simultaneous Gradle build.
limitations: One run per APK; not a statistical claim of improvement.
Key Back benchmark does not measure continuous predictive-back gesture input.
Benchmark APK is optimized and Full-AOT; delivered Debug APK is not performance-equivalent.
No phone FPS, dropped-frame acceptance, or generated Baseline Profile claim.
